name: ppm_quasi_peak
description: IEC 60268-10 Type I and Type II quasi-peak detector: block maxima every 1 ms over a 5 kHz tone-burst sequence (the table bursts, then a 3 s return), plus the table readings of each burst relative to the steady tone.

parameters.burst: x = sin(2 pi f0 k / fs), k = 0..round(T fs)-1, rounded to f32
parameters.sequence_s: silence 0.05, bursts from the table each followed by a 0.5 s gap, the last gap 3 s
parameters.detector:
(identical in `ac2_core::ppm`):

    h    = max(|x|, h·rel)                     peak-held rectifier, released at the return rate
    y_i  = y_i + α_i (h − y_i)   if h > y_i    two first-order charges toward the held peak
         = y_i · rel             otherwise      otherwise the return, linear in dB
    out  = a·y1 + (1 − a)·y2
    α_i  = 1 − exp(−1 / (fs τ_i)),  rel = 10^(−return_db_per_s / (20 fs))
parameters.steady_reference: max detector output over a 400 ms burst

references: IEC 60268-10 (Type I, Type II burst tables and return times) as tabulated in docs/design/programme-meter.md §3

arrays.name: burst_100ms
